varen.name: Marcus Vance
varen.bio: The CEO's right hand. First to offer help, last to be blamed. He always has a plan for you.
varen.publicGoal: Serve the company and keep things calm.

variants.schemer: Marcus wants the top job. Every favour he does for you is another step on his own ladder.
variants.honest: Marcus is hungry for power, but truly loyal. He grabs for control because he thinks only he can keep the company safe.

kovane.name: Dana Kowalski
kovane.bio: Her teams would follow her anywhere. She fears being replaced by people with slide decks.
kovane.publicGoal: Keep projects on time and the teams paid.

variants.steady: Dana would give her all for the company, but only if she feels respected. If you ignore her, she turns fast.
variants.wavering: Other people have already talked to Dana. She will follow whoever promises her teams safety.

dorne.name: Selena Dorsey
dorne.bio: Loved by everyone, great in all-hands meetings, and never seen to want anything.
dorne.publicGoal: Stand up for the people who bring in the money.

variants.populist: Selena truly wants change, and uses charm as a ladder to get it. Her debts hold her more than she admits.
variants.claimant: Selena is quietly building a case to be the next CEO. Being popular is only the first step.

vask.name: Oliver Vasquez
vask.bio: He knows what every company in town owes. He likes to be thanked in person.
vask.publicGoal: Keep the money flowing and the company healthy.

variants.predator: Oliver gives cheap money so leaders depend on him. His real goal is to control the key deals.
variants.patriot: Oliver wants a calm company, because chaos is bad for his money. He is tough, but not an enemy.

ysolde.name: Yara Mendes
ysolde.bio: She sees every calendar and hears every rumour. She trades in what she knows.

variants.neutral: Yara shares news with everyone equally. She is loyal only to her own safety and her notes.
variants.kept: Yara quietly takes favours from someone senior, and her best tips always lean the same way.

anselm.name: Andrew Thorne
anselm.bio: A thin man with a loud conscience. Staff love him. The bosses want him quiet.
anselm.publicGoal: Fair pay for everyone, a shorter work week, and no special treatment for executives.

variants.sincere: Andrew means every word. He also does not know who is paying for his campaign.
variants.zealot: Andrew will take any friend, and give up anything, for his cause. That includes you.

quill.name: Quentin Park
quill.bio: He knows who sits where, who talks to whom, and which door must never be opened.
quill.publicGoal: Keep the CEO's day running smoothly.

variants.leaker: Quentin sells the CEO's calendar to the highest buyer.
variants.clean: Quentin is very careful and treats a leak as treason. He is the most trusted man at HQ, and the most tiring.

rask.name: Ryan Rask
rask.bio: Friendly with whoever is winning. Surprisingly few people hold it against him.
rask.publicGoal: Back the leaders with the most support.

variants.opportunist: Ryan follows power like a weathervane follows the wind. His loyalty is real, until it is not handy.

sabel.name: Imre Sabel
sabel.bio: Charming, from another firm, and a little too well informed. Nobody is sure who pays him.
sabel.publicGoal: Sign a fair partnership between Southline and the company.

variants.agent: Imre works for a rival. He wants access to our core systems. His charm is a tool.
variants.broker: Imre truly wants a fair deal. He is just bad at looking trustworthy.

isaura.name: The Silent Sponsor
isaura.bio: An unsigned message, a car with dark windows, a voice used to being obeyed.

variants.kingmaker: She has picked and broken every rising star for thirty years. She wants her nephew to be CEO, and a helpful leader until then.

aubry.name: Lucas Aubry
aubry.bio: Sees everyone's numbers and tells no one. Almost no one.

variants.honourable: Lucas only wants honest numbers. He will share news with anyone who helps.

aldric.name: Alan Richter
aldric.bio: An older man in a plain jacket. He built the company and does not trust the next team.
aldric.publicGoal: Leave behind a company that stays whole.

variants.tired: Alan knows he will step down soon. He is quietly testing which of you deserves the company.

crowd.name: Colleague
crowd.bio: Interns, engineers, assistants and customers. The company as it really is.

varen_kovane_pact.title: The Meeting Room Deal
varen_kovane_pact.text: Marcus and Dana met late at night and promised to back each other. The delivery team now answers to people who are loyal to each other.

kovane_pay_petition.title: The Team's Request
kovane_pay_petition.text: The late meeting was about unpaid overtime. Marcus offered to carry the request so Dana would not look like a troublemaker.

quill_leaks.title: The Gatekeeper's Side Job
quill_leaks.text: Quentin sells the CEO's weekly calendar to Yara Mendes, who passes it on.

dorne_vask_funds.title: The Star's Investor
dorne_vask_funds.text: Oliver Vasquez has been paying for Selena's big wins: the discounts, the awards and the bonus pool.

vask_funds_pamphlets.title: The Account Behind the Posts
vask_funds_pamphlets.text: Oliver pays for the anonymous posts that attack the bosses. He gains if the old leaders get weak.

poison_cup.title: The Changed Numbers
poison_cup.text: Someone is quietly changing the quarterly numbers. The trail leads to {culprit}.

sabel_pass_scheme.title: The Hidden Access Clause
sabel_pass_scheme.text: The contract Imre pushed on you quietly gives his firm admin access to our core systems.

veiled_hand_identity.title: The Silent Sponsor Found
veiled_hand_identity.text: The Silent Sponsor is Isabel Venn, Chair of the Board. She wants her nephew to be the next CEO.

ledger_page.title: Yara's Screenshots
ledger_page.text: Yara Mendes keeps screenshots of every favour you asked, every price you paid and every person you used.

varen: Since you gave him Delivery, he is oddly often in meeting room 4.
He smiled too widely when you said no.
He seems to keep track of what you tell other people.
kovane: She now treats her team as settled.
She crosses her arms when she talks to you.
dorne: Her favours come with a very good memory.
Her shout-outs always mention the team and never herself.
vask: His notes have a page with your name, neatly ruled.
He says little against the culture plan. That is odd for an investor.
ysolde: She never asks whose side you are on.
anselm: He avoids saying who pays for his campaign.
quill: He made your meeting list without one question. That is not like him.
rask: He agrees with whoever spoke last.
sabel: The gift is beautiful. Its box has a rival firm's logo.
He is strangely pushy about the deadline.
isaura: An unsigned note, a dark car, a faint perfume. Someone arranged your rise.
aubry: He guards the quarterly numbers as if they were his own.
